issues.description: Visibility mismatch for two getter methods declared in the solution: the problem statement and tasks require public getters for every attribute (see problem_statement.md lines 30-34), but the solution implementation declares getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() as private. Specifically, solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java declares "private String getLectureName()" (line 22) and "private int getNumberOfInscribedStudents()" (line 30), whereas the exercise instructs students to implement public getters. This will prevent callers/tests that expect public access from using these methods and contradicts the task description, confusing students and causing automated checks to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getters public in the solution (and ensure the template and instructions indicate public visibility). Change the declarations in solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java to: "public String getLectureName()" and "public int getNumberOfInscribedStudents()". Verify other getters are public as required by the problem statement and update the template comments to explicitly ask for public getters so students are guided correctly.
